metas.name: La cérémonie
metas.description: Chabrol's class thriller about an illiterate maid and a postal clerk who resent a wealthy family. Restrained all the way to a shocking ending.

metas.name: The Clovehitch Killer
metas.description: A Boy Scout in a Christian town begins to suspect his father is a local serial killer. Quiet, suburban and steadily chilling.

metas.name: The Guilty
metas.description: A Danish emergency dispatcher takes a call from a kidnapped woman and tries to save her without leaving his desk. Ninety minutes of rising tension with a crushing turn.

metas.name: Revanche
metas.description: An Austrian ex-con's robbery goes wrong, and he finds himself close to the cop he blames. A slow, tight moral thriller.

metas.name: The Celebration
metas.description: At a patriarch's 60th birthday dinner, his son stands to make a toast that reveals the family's secret. Raw, darkly funny and devastating.

metas.name: Dead Man's Shoes
metas.description: A soldier comes home to take methodical revenge on the small-town thugs who tormented his brother. Brutal, and the reveal changes everything.

metas.name: Red Road
metas.description: A Glasgow CCTV operator spots a man from her past on her screens and begins following him. A quiet surveillance thriller with a sharp ending.

metas.name: Tyrannosaur
metas.description: A violent widower and a charity-shop worker with a secret at home. Harsh British realism in which the cruelty leads to a reckoning.

metas.name: Bedevilled
metas.description: A Seoul banker visits the remote island where her childhood friend is treated like a slave by the whole village. It builds slowly to an explosion of revenge.

metas.name: A Hard Day
metas.description: A corrupt detective hides a body after a hit-and-run, then someone who knows starts calling. A tense, blackly funny Korean thriller.
